negativeList.name: SunBooster | NB | Low Energy | Negatives
notes: solar/outdoor cluster: Keyword Planner showed sun lamp seeds pulling solar garden-light queries
medical cluster: keeps a wellness device out of medical-condition queries (policy + positioning)
vitamin d: deliberately excluded everywhere - SunBooster is 850nm NIR, produces no vitamin D (needs UVB); cannot serve that intent honestly
sad: also blocks 'sad lamp' queries - deliberate, same medical-positioning call
competitor brands negatived to keep the test readable; conquesting is a possible phase 2

excluded_keyword_families.family: vitamin d lamp (4,400/mo), vitamin d light (1,900/mo), sun lamp vitamin d (1,600/mo), uvb light for vitamin d (1,300/mo)
excluded_keyword_families.reason: Product emits 850nm NIR only - no UVB, so it cannot trigger vitamin D synthesis. Buying this traffic would be dishonest and would convert terribly on the Amazon listing.

excluded_keyword_families.family: sad lamp / sun lamp for seasonal depression (2,900/mo) / lamp for depression (1,300/mo)
excluded_keyword_families.reason: Medical-condition territory: Google health policy risk (this account has past disapprovals on old sunlight campaigns) plus a claim the brand cannot make.

excluded_keyword_families.family: sleepy cluster (why am i so sleepy 4,400/mo etc.)
excluded_keyword_families.reason: Leans sleep-disorder/medical rather than energy; weaker product fit. Revisit if the tired cluster wins.
REJECTED at publish by Google policy classifier BIRTH_CONTROL ('morning' read as morning-after pill). Exemptible in theory, but no exemption flow via API - dropped. Batch republished without it.

excluded_keyword_families.family: verilux / sperti / philips wake up light (5,400 + 1,900/mo)
excluded_keyword_families.reason: Competitor conquesting - worth a dedicated phase-2 test, kept out of a clean first read.
